claim: An alias record at the zone apex cannot redirect to a record in the same hosted zone that has the type CNAME. The alias record must have the same type as the record it routes to, and a CNAME at the zone apex is not supported.
question: What is the one exception to creating an alias record at the zone apex?

values.display: must have the same type as the record you're routing traffic to

qualifiers.scope: alias record at the zone apex

evidence.quote: The one exception is when you want to redirect queries from the zone apex (such as example.com) to a record in the same hosted zone that has a type of CNAME (such as zenith.example.com). The alias record must have the same type as the record you're routing traffic to, and creating a CNAME record for the zone apex isn't supported even for an alias record.
